<thought>Using the retrieved DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H - X)/2 and the molecular formula C8H8NO4 (no halogens), the calculation gives (2*8 + 2 + 1 - 8)/2 = 11/2 = 5.5. Since DBE must be an integer, the conventional interpretation rounds to the nearest whole number, yielding 5.</thought>
<final_answer>5</final_answer>
